**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/28 (Sun) 19:45
- [USER] User inquired about IRS Forms W-9 and W-7.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] IRS Form W-9 is used by individuals and businesses to provide their taxpayer identification number (TIN) to another party, typically for reporting payments to the IRS and issuing Form 1099-MISC.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The W-9 form requires the individual or business to provide their name, business name (if applicable), address, TIN, and certification of their taxpayer status.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] IRS Form W-7 is used by nonresident aliens and foreign nationals who need an individual taxpayer identification number (ITIN) to file a tax return with the IRS.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The ITIN is used for tax purposes only and is not a form of work authorization.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The W-7 form requires documentation supporting foreign status and identity, such as a passport, and a valid federal income tax return, unless an exception applies.
- [USER] User pointed out that the form title says "Payee Data Record."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant acknowledged the confusion and clarified that the California STD 204 form is officially titled "Payee Data Record."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The STD 204 form is used by California state agencies to collect information about payees, including individuals, sole proprietors, and businesses.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The purpose of the STD 204 form is to collect information about the payee's name, address, TIN, and other identifying information for tax reporting purposes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The STD 204 form is used to establish new payees in California state agency systems, update existing payee information, and ensure compliance with tax reporting requirements.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The STD 204 form is typically provided to new payees when hired or contracted by a California state agency and must be completed before payment can be received.
- [USER] User asked when the STD 204 form would be used in lieu of W-9 and W-7.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The STD 204 form is not a substitute for the IRS Form W-9 or W-7; the purposes and scopes of the forms are different.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The STD 204 form is specific to California state government transactions, while the W-9 is for federal tax reporting and the W-7 is for obtaining an ITIN for federal tax reporting.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A payee may need to complete both the STD 204 form and the W-9 form if
